headlines.title: Suspect arrested in connection with the kidnapping and killing of Tracy man
headlines.description: A woman was arrested after allegedly threatening her roommates with a firearm in San Jose Saturday afternoon, according to the police department. Officers responded to a report of a disturbance involving an armed suspect at an apartment complex in the 1100 block of Pedro Street around 1:38 p.m., according to authorities. The preliminary investigation revealed a woman reportedly threatened her roommates with a firearm, according to the police department. Authorities said nearby residents were evacuated as a precaution. Police said the woman barricaded herself inside the apartment and refused to exit. After several hours, officers from the departments’ VCET and DSU units responded and took the woman into custody, according to authorities. The police department said this is an ongoing investigation.
